title: Growth Hormone Treatment in Short Children Born Small for Gestational Age
brief_summary: Comparison of 2 different doses of human growth hormone treatment on change in height after 1 and 2 years of treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Born small for gestational age
* actual body height less than or equal -3 SDS
* chronological age greater than 3 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Growth hormone deficiency
* any defined syndromal disease
* Diabetes mellitus
